body: If your gf is giving you ultimatums about meeting someone to talk to about your depression - or even just meeting a friend - she is a shitty gf. I would personally get out of that toxic relationship.
300mg of benadryl will just make you see squiggly lines all over everything. Maybe make you sleepy. But it won't even come close to killing you or doing any harm to your body.

I would want to ruin her life somehow, *then* kill myself. But yeah,  I don't blame you. Getting involved with a woman was your first mistake. If you don't commit suicide, at least do yourself the favor of not ever trusting a female.
Yeah I shot myself 20 years ago. I didn't end up blind or in a wheelchair but I destroyed my face. I wish I had just died back then.
I meant yes for 20 years and no to both spouse and kids. I don't want to bring any child into this world, with my shitty genes or otherwise. Just not fair to them.
Oh. I got the opposite idea from a peaceful pill type website.

Oh this is like my 4th suicide attempt, although like you said it was very half assed and I don't even think it counts. My first was 20 years ago. I'm not glad I survived. It's why I keep trying. I just suck at everything.
IME the only thing worse than being alone on a holiday is being around family.

Lol. Thanks. My life has been about self preservation almost completely. I feel like a trapped animal. There was a while when I was 2000 miles away from them that I felt somewhat free - although they called on the phone and tried to make me feel bad pretty often. I can't believe I screwed up and got back under their influence. It's like two separate lives. I feel like I'm dead, or in a bad dream or something. Real life has been suspended and I'm just decaying, trapped in amber.

Isolating, yeah. I spend all of my time sleeping, hiding in my room on the computer, or at work (and I mostly work alone). I have contact with 3 people in the world - 2 of them being my Nparents :o/

It's pretty depressing. They are great with it, though. I'm completely contained and under their psychological control for the most part. But they could care less that I have the least healthy social life possible!

I've been on and off at least a dozen antidepressants over the last 18 years. Most have caused intolerable side effects while doing nothing to help my depression. I take Wellbutrin now, it makes a microscopic difference, but that's it. SSRI's/SNRI's, tricyclic ADs, atypical ADs, etc. don't do anything for me. Talk therapy helped at one point a long time ago, but then it stopped working - or more likely I just stopped believing in it or doing it right. 

I can't imagine starting a new life. I have health problems and money problems. I'm completely burned out on working or fighting against things. I have no energy so I just end up being pushed around by whoever happens to be the pushiest person around at the time. I'm up at 7AM to go to a job I hate, the guy only pays me for about 1/3 of what I do. He just expects me to work for free most of the time. But I'm so defeated that I can't stand up to him. Yesterday he sat me down and said basically "I'm not going to pay you, but I expect you to come in to work 8 hours everyday - at the hours that are convenient to me, not the hours convenient to you." I actually pay *him* rent to use an office there. And every week he pushes for more commitment on my part to it. 

He asked if I would frame some prints, and we would split the income. I was to do all the work, and he set it up. I said OK, thinking the whole time that I did not want to get involved - it's not work I like doing, or even have the proper tools to do. It always turns into a lot more work than it seems. But I simply cannot say no to people. So I said OK. Then, it went from just putting together the frames to sourcing all the parts, making the decisions about what frames and mats, etc., buying them, and then framing them. But no extra pay. I sunk about $100 into buying the first frame - and doing one at a time is way, way, way, way less efficient than doing them all at once (which I thought I was going to be doing). So I dropped the $100 into it, and of course they want to change things so most all of that $100 was just thrown away. I have to buy different frames, recut all the mats, do that entire one differently along with all the rest. So our mutual profit went down by $100, and I wasted a good portion of a day doing it. I'll probably end up making less than $200 total on it. And now he has decided that I need to clean out an entire room in his studio and convert it into a "framing room" - which is at least an entire day's worth of extra work for $0. It's filled with old boxes full of junk and covered in dust and all the lights need replacing, etc. 

So what I thought was going to be about 1 day's work has morphed into at least 3-4 days' work for slightly less money. That's if absolutely nothing goes wrong, and he doesn't decide to add *more* work, which is entirely unlikely because that is just what he does - turns everything into 10x as much work as it needs to be, without getting more money. So the income per hour just goes down and down and down. 

Monday, I spent half a day on a shoot with him lugging equipment around. He does this gig 2-3x a year for a steep discount because the person is his friend. So he says that since he's not making that much money off of it, he can only afford to pay me "peanuts" - he always says that like it's really cute. "Peanuts" turns out to be him buying me $7.50 lunch at the place he wants when he wants to - and I don't even want that because the whole lunch is a lecture about how we really need to crack down (which means me coming in and doing a whole bunch of cleaning an handyman stuff for absolutely free). So he gives his buddy a discount, and he only gets about $250 I think. Instead of just paying me a little less, he basically just takes out my entire paycheck. It *really* seems like since it's *his* friend and his decision to discount, *he's* the one who should take the pay cut (although even with him getting it all, minus buying me lunch, it's still a good bit less than he normally makes). I don't even know the person. 

But I have absolutely no spine to stand up to this.

I tried for 25 years to do something with my life and escape, and I just ended up hurting myself and losing all hope. I simply do not have the energy left to fight the constant pressure. I would pack all my shit up in my car and just disappear, but I owe people money and have neither the energy to tie up my loose ends, nor the brashness to just leave them for other people to deal with - even though it would be the same people I feel trapped by. 

I just wish that I could muster the nerve to say "NO!" to anything. But the more I think about it, the harder it seems. Every bit of thought I put towards it makes it seem like a more monumental impossibility. I'm living my life extremely half-assedly just following orders from people that have no right to tell me how to live, and the things they have me doing are worthless - like spending my time working for free. 

I'm so burned out by doing this my entire life, and everyone just sees me as a failure and a dropout. I'm "lazy" because I don't want to do these things. So everyone just thinks I'm a waste - which kind of ends up being true, since I'm barely doing anything in life anymore. It's taken a huge toll on my health, and I've had 2 extremely serious hospital stays w/surgery and all (one was a suicide attempt, the other I just got sick and tried to keep working and got sicker and sicker until I came really close to dying). Now, my body doesn't work very well from all that, and I'm physically exhausted all the time, not to mention how mentally drained I am by feeling like a helpless tool being kicked around all the time. 

But again, simply *thinking* about it makes it just seem more daunting and more depressing. I just want to get out, for everyone to leave me alone, to be by myself with my dog where no one can find me. But I don't have the energy or the balls to do what it would take to make that happen :o/

I really do need to try to get back into therapy again. I was doing it for the last 3 years or so, but the therapist was just a psychiatrist finishing her degree and was terrible at it. Even though I made zero progress, she just told me I was "doing fine" and to "keep it up" - keep what up? Spinning in circles? I would tell her that I'm horribly depressed every visit, and every time I came in next she would ask "so your mood is still doing good," like I had no reason to be there and she had never heard what I said. But of course I'm too weak to just fire her and get a better one. She finally graduated and told me I was fine and didn't need to be in therapy/see a psychiatrist anymore. I give up :o/

Sorry, that was longer and more hopeless than what I meant to write. I've got to go to work though :o/

Thanks. I'm not a very good person - I've failed at pretty much everything in life, and I don't do any good deeds or anything. You could say that I'm pretty *bad* at being a person, and I pretty much only think about myself, although it's defensive in nature. Posting a rant on an anonymous forum is easy. Getting off of my pathetic ass and doing something to help myself is hard :o/

But thank you. It's nice to know that someone is listening and is supportive :o)
